prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Pet Selection: Delay account sign-in until after the user picks and customizes their desktop pet. Users complete adoption selection first, increasing investment before authentication.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "body": "Sign in now to lock in your pet choice and sync progress across all your desktop devices.", "hint": "Using the same account restores existing pets without losing data."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Controls Guide Screen: Add a dedicated interactive onboarding screen right before final completion that teaches users how to summon, move, hide, and talk to their pet on the desktop.
   config: {"new_controls_tutorial": {"headline": "How to Interact with Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Click and drag to move your pet, right-click to open actions, or double-click to start chatting.", "layout": "spotlight", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_controls_demo", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "checklist", "text": "Drag to move | Right-click for menu | Double-click to talk", "style": "plain"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Got It!", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_controls_tutorial", "home_intro"]}
2: [adoption, redesign] Split Screen Live Pet Preview: Redesign the pick_friend screen with a two-column layout showing a live desktop preview of the pet on the left alongside selection controls on the right.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "body": "See how your pet will look and move right on your screen before adopting.", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select breed and color", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}, {"role": "pet_choices", "type": "preview", "asset": "asset:desktop_pet_live_preview", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive Pet Hatching Wait Flow: Transform the waiting screen into an interactive pet hatching sequence with tip carousels and desktop permission readiness checks.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Your Pet is Preparing Its Desktop Home...", "body": "We are generating high-res animations and configuring screen overlays.", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10, "replace": {"wait_status": [{"role": "wait_status", "type": "animation", "asset": "asset:hatching_egg_anim", "style": "playful"}, {"role": "wait_status", "type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: Press Alt+P anytime to summon your pet instantly.", "style": "subtle", "action": "open_tip"}]}}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync & Pet Recovery Hint: Add clear helper text below sign-in options explaining how logging in restores existing adoption certificates and saved pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Already have a pet? Sign in with your original account to automatically restore your pet and stats."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress Bar & Time Estimate: Display explicit progress percentages and estimated seconds remaining while the app prepares the pet on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Setting Up Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Please keep this window open while we finish rendering your pet."}}
6: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Quality Guidelines: Add photo selection guidelines and explicit tips on lighting and contrast directly on the photo upload screen.

   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose How to Create Your Pet", "body": "Pick a quick preset for instant fun or customize from scratch. Both come with free starter items!", "replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "type": "badge", "text": "Includes Free Starter Pack", "style": "highlight"}, {"role": "path_options", "type": "choice_cards", "text": "Preset Pet (Instant) vs Custom Creation", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}}
8: [finish, layout] Spotlight Layout for Final Desktop Welcome: Reframe home_intro screen with a spotlight layout featuring shortcut hints and an instant desktop summoning test button.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!", "body": "Look at your desktop to meet your new friend, or click below to test summoning.", "button_label": "Meet My Pet Now", "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Test Desktop Call", "action": "play", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification: Enable desktop notification alert when pet preparation finishes on the waiting screen so users know when their pet drops onto the desktop.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "You will receive a system notification as soon as your pet arrives on your desktop."}}

verdicts.reason: Moving sign-in after pet selection is explicitly allowed under onboarding rules.
Adding an interactive tutorial screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning the pet selection layout preserves its core job.
Interactive hatching sequence maintains the waiting screen's purpose.
Adding sign-in recovery hint is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding a real progress estimate to the waiting screen is permitted.
Photo upload quality guidelines improve onboarding without violating rules.
Onboarding copy mentions free starter items/packs, violating Rule 3.
Redesigning the home intro overlay layout is allowed.
Adding system notification configuration on the waiting screen is allowed.
